continuePrompt.description: Message sent to trigger the continuation turn after editing an assistant message (hidden by default).
continuePrompt.default: I edited your previous message. Continue from there.

defaultAction.description: Action taken when you press Esc on the 'what next?' prompt.

hideContinuePrompt.description: Send the continuation prompt as a hidden custom message: it stays in LLM context but is not rendered as a user turn in the transcript. Set false for the old visible behaviour.
